$comment: 각 포즈의 생성 지시. {breed}, {coat}, {features}, {exclude}는 mascot.config.json의 appearance에서 채워집니다.

poses.label: 네 발로 서서 정면 보기
poses.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent desktop mascot sprite, idle-stand/front key pose. Primary request: create a single clean, full-body cutout of the same {breed}, standing squarely on all four legs and facing the viewer with the head lifted slightly; preserve {features} and {coat}. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background. Composition/framing: centered subject, generous transparent margins, all four paws and both ears fully visible, feet aligned near the bottom. Lighting/mood: soft natural indoor light. Constraints: change only background and production cleanup; preserve the dog's identity and pose; {exclude}; no floor, no shadow, no text, no watermark.

poses.label: 두 발로 서서 앞발 내밀기
poses.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: transparent desktop mascot sprite, stand-up/front key pose. Primary request: create a single clean, full-body cutout of the same {breed}, upright on the hind legs facing the viewer, with both front paws gently extended toward the screen; preserve {features} and {coat}. Scene/backdrop: genuinely transparent background. Composition/framing: centered subject, generous transparent margins, paws and ears fully visible, feet aligned near the bottom. Lighting/mood: soft natural indoor light. Constraints: change only background and production cleanup; preserve the dog's identity and pose; {exclude}; no floor, no shadow, no text, no watermark.
